tools.name: search_investors
tools.description: Search InvestorMatch's public directory of venture capital firms. Filter by firm name (query), stage, sector and HQ location; results are sorted alphabetically, 25 per page (up to page 20). Each result has the firm's stages, sectors, check size, a thesis summary and a link to its InvestorMatch profi

tools.name: get_investor
tools.description: Get a venture capital firm's full public InvestorMatch profile by its slug (from search_investors): thesis, stages, sectors, check size, partners and their focus, recent portfolio companies, funds and how the firm prefers to be approached. Contact emails are never included.

tools.name: list_investor_filters
tools.description: List the exact stage, sector and location values search_investors accepts as filters.

tools.name: search_fundraising_guides
tools.description: Search InvestorMatch's published fundraising guides and articles (pitch decks, investor outreach, valuations, term sheets and more). Returns up to 10 articles with a title, excerpt and link. Leave query empty for the latest articles.
